name: workforce360
description: Workforce 360 ERP — monorepo (Next.js web + Express API)

scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w web && npm run lint -w api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w api
scripts.test: npm run test -w api && npm run test -w web
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:ci -w api && npm run test:ci -w web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w api && npm run test:coverage -w web
